name: Entity Page Title Manage Display
description: A dedicated view mode to manage the entity page title display.
project_description:
This module allow site builder to create and customise an entity page title view mode.

When this view mode is customised and configured it will replace the core page title block.

This is useful for display more information than the title in the page title section, exemple : a cover, a section or the orther in the same area than the default page title

 Post-Installation 
 After the installation go to any entity manage display and customise the "Page Title" view mode.

Add the title and other desired field trough the manage display.

When done the page title of the entity full page will be replaced by the configured view mode.
